resources.string: Quran, hadith kple adhkar nuŋlɔɖiwo toa mawusubɔsubɔ me toto tɔxɛ aɖe me, si to vovo tso sededewo me toto gbɔ, hafi woɖea wo ɖe go le se nu. Quran ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ dzɔtsoƒe: Tanzil dɔ (Uthmani nuŋɔŋlɔ).

Muslim nye dɔwɔnu si woate ŋu azã femaxee keŋkeŋ, si woate ŋu azã le GPLv3 ƒe mɔɖegbalẽ te — boblododo aɖeke mele eme o, nudɔdɔ aɖeke meli o, kplɔkplɔ aɖeke mele eme o. Eƒe tɔtrɔ ɖesiaɖe si ŋu wotrɔ asi le la nɔa ʋuʋu ɖi.

Femaxee tegbee · Ame ŋutɔ ƒe nyawo gbã · Ɣletiviŋutinunya ƒe nyateƒetoto le gbedodoɖaɣiwo kple qibla me · Ewɔa dɔ le internet dzi · Kpekpeɖeŋu na senyawo sukuwo to nɔnɔme siwo woate ŋu atrɔ asi le me.
Adhan ƒe gbeɖiɖi kple eƒe nyanyanana le gbedodoɖa ɖesiaɖe me
Adhkar ŋkuɖodzinyawo kple nusi wotsɔ tsyɔ edzi si le tsia dzi
Gbesiagbe hadith si me woɖoa ŋku nyagblɔɖi ƒe mɔfiame dzi le
Gbesiagbe ŋkuɖodzinu na kɔnu si woɖo be woawɔ le eƒe ɣeyiɣi me le Hajj ŋkekeawo me
Nyatakaka si nɔa anyi ɖaa si ɖea adhan si kplɔe ɖo, ɣeyiɣi si susɔ, kple adhan si to la fiana
Gbesiagbe ayah si me amekpekpe be woaxlẽ ahade ŋugble le
Iftar kple suhoor ƒe nuxlɔ̃amewo le Ramadan me
Nyatakaka si me fefe / ɖiɖiɖeme / tɔtrɔ ƒe dziɖuɖuwo le esime wole Quran la xlẽm
Ŋkuɖodzia do ŋgɔ na gbedodoɖa ƒe ɣeyiɣia, le offset si nètia me
Woxe mɔ ɖe enu to ɖoɖoa dzi
Nyatakaka si anɔ anyi ɖaa si ɖe gbedodoɖa si kplɔe ɖo kple ɣeyiɣi si susɔ fia, si wowɔ yeyee le agbe.
Nyatakaka ƒe ŋgɔdonya si yi edzi
Be nàxɔ adhan kple gbesiagbe ŋkuɖodzinyawo la, na dɔwɔnua naɖe gbeƒãɖeɖewo afia.

Mizi nyatakakawo katã (negbe adhan koe mele eme o) le fesre si nètia la me
Esia nye dodokpɔ ƒe nyatakaka tso nyatakaka ƒe ɖoɖowo me.
Dɔwɔwɔ ƒe nyatakaka ɖesiaɖe dzi kpɔkpɔ bliboe le teƒe ɖeka. Ne èwɔ hatsotso aɖe nuwɔametɔe la, ate fli ɖe eƒe nyatakaka siwo le lalam la me enumake.
Wona mɔɖeɖewo katã — dɔwɔnua le dɔ wɔm le eƒe ŋutete bliboa me
Mɔɖeɖe siwo bu nana nana adhan kple ŋkuɖodzinyawo nɔa game dzi
Mehiã le mɔ̃ sia dzi o

Muslim dea bubu wò nyatakakawo ŋu eye meƒoa wò nyatakakawo nu ƒu o.

• Womekpɔa wo yome o: ad SDKs, analytics alo marketing trackers aɖeke meli o.
• Nyatakakawo nɔa wò mɔ̃a dzi: wodzraa wò nyatakakawo katã (teƒe, ɖoɖowo, agbalẽdzesiwo) ɖo le mia gbɔ le wò mɔ̃a dzi ɖeɖeko.
• Wozãa teƒe si nèle le mia gbɔ: wozãa wò kɔordinatewo tsɔ bua gbedodoɖa ɣeyiɣiwo kple qibla si le wò mɔ̃a dzi, eye womeɖonɛ ɖe gotagome dɔwɔƒe aɖeke gbeɖe o.
• Mɔɖeɖewo ne ehiã ko: ne nɔnɔme aɖe hiã wo ŋutɔŋutɔ ko hafi míebiaa mɔɖeɖewo (teƒe si wole, nyatakakawo), kple numeɖeɖe si me kɔ.
• Kadodo si dzi wozi o: dɔwɔnua wɔa dɔ le Internet dzi; network zazã nye tiatia blibo na kpeɖeŋutɔ abe recitations ƒe kɔpi wɔwɔ.

Ðoɖo sia nye nudzraɖoƒe si woʋu ɖi ƒe akpa aɖe eye woʋu mɔ na nutoa me tɔwo ƒe ŋkuléle ɖe eŋu.

Xɔlɔ̃ blibo, si le ablɔɖe me, si woate ŋu azã faa na Moslemtɔ ɖesiaɖe — gbedodoɖaɣiwo, Adhan, Quran, hadith, adhkar kple bubuwo, le wò gbe me.

Muslim nye Android dɔwɔnu si woate ŋu azã femaxee eye wòʋu ɖi si kpena ɖe ŋuwò le ŋkekea me katã: gbedodoɖa ɣeyiɣi siwo sɔ pɛpɛpɛ le ɣletivimefakaka nu kple Adhan, Qibla kɔmpasi si sɔ pɛpɛpɛ, Quran blibo si me nuxexlẽ kple tafsir le, hadith agbalẽdzraɖoƒe, adhkar si wokpɔ tso teƒea, elektrɔnik tasbih, Ramadan dɔwɔnuwo, zakat akɔntabubumɔ̃, anyigbatata siwo mele Internet dzi o, kple bubuwo — wowɔe be wòawɔ dɔ bliboe le Internet dzi kple adzamenyawo to default.
Nusianu si Moslemtɔ hiã le dɔwɔnu ɖeka me:
Gbedodoɖa ɣeyiɣiwo & Adhan — akɔntabubu mɔnuwo katã, senyawo sukuwo, kple 18+ adhan gbeɖiɖiwo
Quran blibo — Uthmani ŋɔŋlɔ, nuxlẽla 44, tafsir, gbegɔmeɖeɖewo, nyawo didi & zi gbɔ zi geɖe
Adhkar, tasbih, Ramadan & Zakat — kple ŋkuɖodzinyawo kple kuɖɔ siwo le tsia dzi
Offline-gbãtɔ — anyigbatatawo, Quran, hadith kple adhkar wɔa dɔ kple internet aɖeke o
Adzamenyawo le gɔmedzedzea me — boblododo aɖeke, kplɔkplɔ aɖeke meli o, wò nyatakakawo nɔa wò mɔ̃a dzi
